about: The optional parts of BUI: one table read by CMake (features.cmake: an option each), cargo (blenderui-sys/build.rs maps cargo features to those options and checks Cargo.toml lists them all) and `bui build` (bindings/node/features.js: which runtime an app needs). A part that is off costs no binary size; its API stays (it reports the part missing). One feature per line: build.rs reads it line by line.

features.name: svg
features.doc: SVG images (nanosvg, which the icons use anyway: no extra code)

features.name: video
features.doc: <video> through the OS decoders (Media Foundation, AVFoundation, GStreamer), loaded at run time

features.name: video-dav1d
features.doc: AV1 video with dav1d (BSD-2) and a small MP4/WebM demuxer, where the OS has no AV1 decoder

features.name: video-ffmpeg
features.doc: Every format FFmpeg reads (libavformat/libavcodec, LGPL or GPL by its build; patent-encumbered codecs)

features.name: gpu
features.doc: GPU renderers: Direct3D 11 (Windows), OpenGL 3.3 (Linux); without it, the software raster only

features.name: freetype
features.doc: Text through the vendored FreeType like Blender's BLF (else stb_truetype); every bui build runtime has it, so text looks the same

features.name: filebrowser
features.doc: Blender's File Browser (the filebrowser node and BK_file_dialog)

features.name: imgui
features.doc: Dear ImGui on BUI (C++; the blenderui-imgui crate and Python's blenderui.imgui turn it on)

runtimes.name: full
runtimes.doc: everything a JavaScript app can use
